headline: Sensex Gains 333 Points, Nifty Reclaims 23,200 Level Driven By FMCG
why: FMCG and metal stocks saw strong buying interest ahead of the Fed outcome.
Markets snapped a two-day losing streak despite pressure on IT counters.
RBI intervention helped limit losses as the Rupee hovered near six-week lows.
whatHappening: Union Cabinet approved raising the EPFO wage ceiling to ₹25,000 per month.
Tata Sons IPO order backed Shapoor Mistry's long-running request.
Indian Rupee languished at a six-week low ahead of the US Fed verdict.
NSE IPO developments highlighted significant wealth impact for major investors like Radhakishan Damani.

stocksInNews.sources: In focus among traders during opening session.
IT sector dragged main indices ahead of Fed interest rate verdict.
FMCG sector rallied nearly 2%, boosting benchmark indices.
Metals sector rallied alongside Tata Sons IPO ruling developments.

summary: Indian benchmark indices closed higher with Sensex gaining over 300 points and Nifty settling above 23,200. Gains were led by FMCG and metal stocks while IT dragged, amid key macro updates like the EPFO wage ceiling hike.
